watchlist.name: ServiceNow
watchlist.coreMetric: Q2 subscription revenue $3.877B, +24.5% YoY; cRPO $13.2B, +21%; RPO $29.0B, +21%; AI ACV >$1B; FY26 subscription-revenue outlook raised
watchlist.thesis: Enterprise workflow + AI Control Tower; system of action for human and agent workflows, with agentic deployments scaling rapidly.
watchlist.risk: Agentic AI could abstract the UI; M&A and SBC discipline matter.

watchlist.name: Zscaler
watchlist.coreMetric: FY26 Q4 revenue $898.2M, +25% YoY; ARR $3.771B, +25% including Red Canary / +20% organic; net new ARR $246M; FY26 FCF margin 23%; RPO ~$7.4B, +27%
watchlist.thesis: Zero Trust for users, workloads and AI agents; Agentic SOC + data security create meaningful AI-era expansion vectors.
watchlist.risk: Organic ARR growth is closer to 20% after adjusting for Red Canary; FY27 rerating requires sustained organic acceleration and clean acquisition integration.

watchlist.name: Rubrik
watchlist.coreMetric: FY27 Q2 subscription ARR $1.66B, +33% YoY; cloud ARR $1.48B, +39%; revenue $427.3M, +38%; FCF $65.7M / 15% margin; FY27 ARR/revenue/FCF guidance raised
watchlist.thesis: Cyber resilience + Rubrik AI + Agent Cloud combine recovery, data security and autonomous AI-agent protection; improving operating leverage adds a second earnings driver.
watchlist.risk: Premium multiple and still-large SBC require >30% ARR growth and continued margin expansion; execution risk rises as the platform broadens into agentic security.

watchlist.name: Fortinet
watchlist.coreMetric: Secure networking/SASE growth with unusually strong cash generation; FY26 revenue and billings outlook was raised after Q1; Virtue AI acquisition expands runtime/agentic AI protection
watchlist.thesis: Secure networking + SASE + AI workload protection; Virtue AI expands continuous validation and runtime security for autonomous AI systems.
watchlist.risk: Valuation is no longer cheap; AI-security purity and software mix remain lower than ZS/CRWD.

watchlist.name: Micron Technology
watchlist.coreMetric: FQ3 revenue $41.46B vs $9.30B YoY; FQ4 revenue guide $50B +/- $1B with ~86% gross margin; HBM4 in high-volume shipments; next earnings Sep 30, 2026
watchlist.thesis: AI memory cycle, HBM4 demand and data-center DRAM/NAND growth; strategic customer agreements and constrained advanced-memory supply support exceptional earnings power.
watchlist.risk: Highly cyclical memory pricing and record capex intensity; expectations are extreme after the large rerating and Sep 30 earnings create event risk.

watchlist.name: CrowdStrike
watchlist.coreMetric: FY27 Q2 revenue $1.47B, +26%; ARR $5.84B, +25%; record net new ARR $333M, +51%; Falcon Flex ARR $2.29B, +101%; FCF $377M / 26% margin; FY27 net-new-ARR growth guide raised to 34% midpoint
watchlist.thesis: Cloud-native security platform spanning endpoint, identity, cloud, SIEM and AI-agent security; accelerating net-new ARR and Falcon Flex adoption strengthen the consolidation thesis.
watchlist.risk: Exceptional execution is already reflected in an extreme valuation; even modest growth or multiple normalization can create sharp drawdowns.

watchlist.name: Snowflake
watchlist.coreMetric: FY27 Q2 revenue $1.55B, +35%; product revenue $1.492B, +37%; RPO $9.0B, +30%; NRR 126%; FY27 product-revenue guide raised to $6.07B / +36%; adjusted FCF margin guide 23%
watchlist.thesis: Enterprise data + AI consumption platform; product-revenue growth has reaccelerated for three straight quarters while CoCo/CoWork adoption shows AI workloads are becoming a material consumption driver.
watchlist.risk: Premium valuation and high SBC remain the key constraints; competition from Databricks and hyperscalers requires sustained product velocity and consumption growth.

watchlist.name: Bloom Energy
watchlist.coreMetric: Q2 revenue $1.065B, +165.5% YoY; product revenue +215%; FY26 revenue guidance raised to $3.9B-$4.2B (~100% growth at midpoint); AI data-center power demand remains the key catalyst
watchlist.thesis: On-site power for data centers; AI-driven electricity demand can accelerate deployments where grid interconnection is the bottleneck.
watchlist.risk: Project execution, financing needs, customer concentration, policy exposure and volatile expectations.

watchlist.name: Corning
watchlist.coreMetric: Q2 core sales $4.74B, +17%; Optical Communications sales $2.07B, +32%; Enterprise Networks +65% with GenAI products growing faster; Sep 11 ATM program allows up to $2B of common-stock issuance
watchlist.thesis: Optical connectivity and fiber demand from AI data-center buildouts; accelerating Enterprise Networks sales provide a direct read-through from GenAI infrastructure capex.
watchlist.risk: AI exposure is indirect and partly cyclical; the $2B ATM equity program adds dilution and technical-overhang risk.
